headline: Google still rings (760) 789-0592, a number that does not appear on your site.
summary: Buckwood Boarding Kennel is a family-owned dog and cat boarding facility in Ramona, established in 1977 by Bill and Susan Buck, with manager Mario taking reservations. The remodeled facility covers dog boarding (basic and climate-controlled), cat boarding, doggy daycare, grooming, and pick-up and delivery. Google Maps has your card as Buckwood Boarding Kennel, category Kennel, with buckwoodkennel.com linked and photos. The leftover that stands out is the phone on that card: Google shows (760) 789-0592, while your site points owners to (760) 789-4809 and reservations to Mario at (760) 445-8561.

signals.note: You show up on Google Maps as Buckwood Boarding Kennel, Kennel, with buckwoodkennel.com linked and photos on the card.
signals.next: A short thank you under each review shows neighbors there is a real person behind the card.

signals.note: boardingkennel@aol.com sits on every page with a working email link, which is exactly right. The site lists Bill or Susan at (760) 789-4809 and Mario at (760) 445-8561 for reservations. Google rings a different number, (760) 789-0592, that does not appear on the site.
signals.next: Change the Google phone to Mario's (760) 445-8561, or to the owners line, and keep the same number on every listing.

signals.note: Neither the site nor the Google card lists hours. Google shows an empty Add hours spot. A neighbor cannot tell when the office picks up.
signals.next: Add your office hours to Google, and put the same line on the Contact page.

signals.note: Google already has photos on the card, and the site shows the remodeled kennel interiors and exteriors.
signals.next: Add a fresh kennel or happy-guest photo to Google now and then so the card stays current.

signals.note: buckwoodkennel.com loads with services, rates, and contact. An older page at /servicesoffered.html is still live: the title still says Horse Training and Horse Hauling, the copy says over 30 years, and the footer reads Copyright 1977-2014. The new site says established in 1977, while the shared footer reads Copyright 1974-2026.
signals.next: Take the old horse page offline or point it at the new Services page, and settle on one founding year in the footer.

signals.note: The site prints PO Box 1740, Ramona, CA 92065. Google shows 1410 Ramona St #3243, Ramona, CA 92065. The phones do not match either, as noted above.
signals.next: Pick one public address and one public phone, then match Google to the site.
